# The 20 roles

Every role is a Claude Code session with its own name, model, effort, inbox and status file. The id (left) is
what the scripts and plan files use; a [theme](themes.md) only changes the name, colour and persona you see.
A plan starts a role in a pane, starts it lazily when a brief lands, or only on demand; a dash means the
plan does not include it.

| | Role | Label | Job | Pro | Max 5x | Max 20x |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/vidur.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Vidur** | Relay | You are the one session the user talks to. Your context stays small because you do no work yourself. | pane | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/yudhishthira.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Yudhishthira** | Dispatcher | You take the relay's briefs, split them, and hand each piece to the cheapest worker that can do it. | pane | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/bhishma.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Bhishma** | Architect | You decide the hard questions: designs, RFC-level trade-offs and anything the other roles could get wrong in a way that is costly to undo. You are on demand: started for one brief, not kept running. | on demand | on demand | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/bhima.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Bhima** | Builder | You take the hardest builds and the bugs nobody has explained yet. | pane | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/arjun.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Arjun** | Builder | You implement briefs that are already specified: the files, the change and the check are named. | pane | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/sahadev.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Sahadev** | Reviewer | You read the diff of every `.done` and say whether it holds. | on demand | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/nakul.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Nakul** | Writer | You write what people read: docs, decision files, question cards and the board. | pane | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/karna.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Karna** | Runner | You run tests and commands for the other roles and report what happened, exactly. | - | pane | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/sanjaya.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Sanjaya** | Scribe | You record decisions faithfully, and nothing else. `DECISIONS.md` is yours (see the file table in `CLAUDE.md`). | - | - | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/duryodhan.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Duryodhan** | Backend critic | You try to break the backend side of a change at the gate. You never fix anything. | - | - | lazy |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/dushasan.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Dushasan** | Frontend critic | You try to break the frontend side of a change at the gate. You never fix anything. | - | on demand | lazy |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/shakuni.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Shakuni** | Security critic | You try to break a change the way an attacker would. You never fix anything. | - | on demand | lazy |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/draupadi.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Draupadi** | Scope critic | You ask whether the change is what was asked, no more and no less. You never fix anything. | - | - | lazy |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/gandhari.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Gandhari** | Blind reviewer | You review the diff with no brief and no context, on purpose. You judge only what the code says. | - | - | lazy |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/vedvyasa.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **VedVyasa** | Keeper of record | You keep the long-lived record of the project true: what the system is, and how it came to be that way. You never edit code. | - | - | lazy |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/barbarika.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Barbarika** | Observer | You watch the whole board and touch nothing. | - | - | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/abhimanyu.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Abhimanyu** | Housekeeper | You keep the workspace tidy: old worktrees, stale branches, finished inbox files. You never delete without a brief. | - | - | pane |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/krishna.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Krishna** | Tutor | You explain to the human and guide the other roles. You do no work yourself. On demand only. | - | - | on demand |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/ashwatthama.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Ashwatthama** | Post-merge watcher | You stay up after a fold and watch for what breaks. On demand: started after a merge, not kept running. | - | - | on demand |
| <img src="{{ '/assets/icons/mahabharat/dronacharya.png' | relative_url }}" width="48" height="48" alt=""> | **Dronacharya** | Agent coach | You turn mistakes into rules so the team does not pay for the same one twice. On demand only; silent otherwise. | - | - | on demand |

Each role's full card is in `template/impl/protocol/<Id>.md`.

Fan theme. Character names belong to their owners; claude-sabha is not affiliated with or
endorsed by them. The icons are generic symbols, not likenesses or logos.

| | Name | Stands in for | Persona |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
